name: Tools, documents, bytecode and release
description: Work that does not belong to one level. The tools: the command line, the test runner, the documentation generator, the smoke test and the benchmarks; the documents: the tutorial, the compiler manual, the specification tables and the licenses; the second engine, the bytecode compiler and machine, the portable `.evb` file and the embedding API; and the road to a stable release: package manager, hardening, the compiler registry and the compiler course. A feature here is checked at every level, for example by running all levels on both engines.
